summary: Finalized implementation plan incorporating all 5 critical corrections: pinned Prisma ORM v6 with consistent Neon connection pooling and direct migration configuration, default-unpublished protection (isPublished: false) to prevent unverified content exposure, dedicated public review moderation endpoint (/api/reviews/submit), removal of all unverified business details (empty contact email, no fabricated prices/credentials), and concrete executable verification scripts (prisma validate, prisma generate, npm run build).
